name: Sunriver
label: Sunriver
about_prose: Sunriver is a 3,300-acre master-planned resort and residential community 15 miles south of Bend along the eastern bank of the Deschutes River. The site was originally Camp Abbot, a U.S. Army engineer training facility that operated from 1942 to 1944. Portland developer John Gray acquired the former military tract in 1965, the first homesites sold in 1968, and Skidmore, Owings and Merrill completed the master plan in 1969.

The community holds roughly 4,200 homesites, a mix of single-family homes, condominiums, and cabins. About 2,023 residents (2020 Census) live there full time, with the balance held as vacation homes. The Sunriver Owners Association governs common areas, the paved-path network, and community facilities, while Sunriver Resort runs the hotel, golf courses, spa, marina, and stables.
Elevation sits at 4,170 feet, with more than 300 days of sun a year. Mt. Bachelor, one of the largest ski areas in the Pacific Northwest, is a 30-minute drive up the Cascade Lakes Highway.

amenities.name: Crosswater Club
amenities.description: A 600-acre heathland-style course by Robert E. Cupp, opened 1995. The Deschutes and Little Deschutes rivers come into play on several holes. Ranked among Golf Digest's 100 Greatest Courses.
amenities.access: Members and Sunriver Resort guests only

amenities.name: Woodlands Course
amenities.description: 18-hole course by Robert Trent Jones Jr., opened 1982. Par 72, 6,847 yards, slope 143.
amenities.access: Resort guests and public tee times

amenities.name: Meadows Course
amenities.description: 18-hole course opened 1969, redesigned by John Fought in 1999. Par 71, 7,012 yards, slope 140.
amenities.access: Resort guests and public tee times

amenities.name: SHARC Aquatic and Recreation Center
amenities.description: A 22-acre facility with a seasonal lazy river, water slides, a tot pool, a year-round snow-tubing hill, disc golf, and event space.

amenities.name: Paved Path Network
amenities.description: 34 miles of paved paths separated from roads, plus a 12-mile round-trip Sun Lava Path to Benham Falls and the Lava Lands Visitor Center.

amenities.name: Sunriver Marina
amenities.description: Deschutes River marina renting canoes, kayaks, paddleboards, tubes, and rafts, with shuttle service for a 6-mile float.

amenities.name: Sunriver Stables
amenities.description: Guided trail rides through pine forest, seasonally mid-April through September, with pony rides available.

amenities.name: The Cove Aquatic Center
amenities.description: 10,000-square-foot indoor facility with a heated pool, lazy river, two-story waterslide, splash pad, and outdoor spas.

amenities.name: Sunriver Nature Center and Observatory
amenities.description: An eight-acre campus established in 1968. The observatory holds the largest publicly accessible telescope collection in the United States. Sunriver earned a Dark Sky designation in 2020.

amenities.name: The Village at Sunriver
amenities.description: A commercial district of locally owned restaurants and shops, including Sunriver Brewing Company.

drive_times.note: Via Century Drive / Cascade Lakes Highway
Newberry National Volcanic Monument, 6 miles northeast

course_specs.summary: Five courses: Crosswater (1995, Robert E. Cupp, private/resort-guest, Golf Digest Top 100), Woodlands (1982, Robert Trent Jones Jr., par 72, 6,847 yds), Meadows (1969, redesigned by John Fought 1999, par 71, 7,012 yds), plus the shorter family courses Caldera Links and Gray's Trail.
